education.qualification: Diploma in Information and Communication Technology (Applications Development)

cvs.summary: Final-year ICT (Applications Development) student at the University of Mpumalanga with hands-on experience designing and building full-stack web applications end to end, from database schema and REST APIs through to authentication and frontend integration. Comfortable working across the stack in JavaScript, PHP, and Java, with a strong grounding in software engineering practice (requirements analysis, UML modelling, Agile/Scrum, and testing). Seeking a junior software developer or internship role to apply and grow full-stack development skills in a professional environment.

skills.text: JavaScript, PHP, Java, HTML & CSS, SQL
Node.js (Express), REST API design, JWT authentication, MVC / layered architecture
Jakarta EE (Servlets, JSF, RESTful services), XAMPP, Git/GitHub
MySQL (schema design, normalization, advanced SQL, CRUD operations)
Requirements engineering, UML/system modelling, Agile & Scrum practices, test-driven development, object-oriented design & design patterns

projects.name: Taskify: Campus Task & Equipment Marketplace
projects.tech: Node.js, Express, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
projects.description: Full-stack web application enabling students to post tasks, hire services, and rent equipment within a secure campus-based marketplace.
bullets: Implemented JWT-based authentication to secure user accounts and API access
Designed a full task lifecycle system (Posted → Accepted → In Progress → Completed)
Built an equipment rental system with booking and return-tracking functionality
Developed a rating and review system to establish trust between users
Created a payment simulation system to mimic escrow-style transactions
Designed RESTful APIs and integrated frontend with backend services
Implemented reporting and moderation features to improve platform safety

projects.name: FUEL SA: Fuel Station Management System
projects.tech: Java, JavaFX, FXML, Scene Builder, CSS
projects.description: Desktop fuel station management application simulating station operations through an interactive GUI.
bullets: Built using object-oriented programming principles with modular separation of logic, controllers, and UI
Implemented fuel request functionality with input validation and event-driven interactions
Designed responsive interfaces using FXML and Scene Builder, styled with JavaFX CSS

coursework.text: Web Development:
dynamic web content, PHP (OOP, arrays, forms), MySQL (joins, PDO), JavaScript (DOM, objects), sessions & authentication
Application Development (Jakarta EE):
Servlets, JSF, RESTful web services, JSON binding, persistence/ORM, microservices
Software Engineering:
SDLC, requirements engineering, UML system modelling, architectural design, Agile/Scrum, software testing

cvs.summary: Final-year ICT (Applications Development) student at the University of Mpumalanga with practical experience building Android applications from the ground up: UI design, local data persistence, third-party API integration, and background services. Built HealthWise, an AI-assisted symptom-checker app, covering the full Android development lifecycle from interface design through to deployment-ready builds. Seeking a junior Android/mobile developer or internship role to grow professional mobile development experience.

skills.text: Android Studio, XML layouts & Material Design, Activities/Fragments & lifecycle management, event handling & intents, AlarmManager, RecyclerView
Room Database, SQLite, SharedPreferences, Retrofit (REST API consumption), JSON parsing, Firebase integration
Google Maps API & location services, multimedia integration, Git/GitHub, app testing, debugging & performance profiling, signed APK/AAB packaging
Object-oriented design, MVVM/MVC patterns, UML modelling, Agile/Scrum practices

projects.name: HealthWise: AI-Based Symptom Checker App
projects.tech: Java, Android Studio, Retrofit, Room Database

cvs.roleTitle: Junior Database Developer / Data-Focused ICT Graduate
cvs.summary: Final-year ICT (Applications Development) student at the University of Mpumalanga with a strong grounding in relational database design, from entity-relationship modelling and normalization through to advanced SQL, performance tuning, and emerging NoSQL/Big Data concepts. Applied this knowledge practically by designing and querying MySQL databases for two full production-style applications. Seeking a junior database developer, data analyst, or database administration role to build on this academic and applied foundation.

skills.text: Entity-Relationship (ER) modelling, normalization (up to higher normal forms), relational schema design, data modelling (conceptual, logical, physical)
Data definition & manipulation, complex queries, joins, relational set operators, SQL functions, stored procedures, transaction processing
MySQL, SQLite, Room Database (Android), MySQL Workbench
Transaction management & concurrency control, database performance tuning & query optimization, distributed database systems, database security & administration
Big Data & Hadoop concepts, NoSQL (MongoDB, Neo4j), business intelligence & data warehousing, star schemas, SQL analytical functions
REST API integration with databases, CRUD operations, backend data architecture

cvs.roleTitle: IT Support Technician / Junior Network Technician
cvs.summary: Final-year ICT (Applications Development) student at the University of Mpumalanga with a solid technical support and networking foundation, covering hardware/software troubleshooting (CompTIA A+ syllabus), network design and configuration (CompTIA Network+ syllabus), and IT service management best practice (ITIL v3 Foundation). Practical experience includes designing and configuring a two-campus WAN with segmented wireless networks. Seeking an IT Support, Help Desk, or Junior Network Technician role to apply and build on this foundation in a live production environment.

skills.text: PC hardware configuration & diagnostics, motherboard/memory/CPU/GPU components, laptop hardware & repairs, printer installation & troubleshooting, mobile device setup, sync, backup and security

OSI/TCP-IP models, IP addressing & subnetting, routing & switching, VLANs & network segmentation, DHCP/DNS/NAT, wireless network configuration, WAN design, VPN & remote access, network troubleshooting
Cisco Packet Tracer, Windows environment administration, command-line basics & scripting fundamentals

service lifecycle (strategy, design, transition, operation, continual improvement), incident/service request handling awareness, service level & availability management, change and service transition principles
technician conduct & communication, active listening, client-facing troubleshooting, IT ethics

projects.name: Two-Campus WAN Design & Configuration
projects.description: Designed and configured a complete two-campus wide area network as a practical networking exercise.
bullets: Built LAN infrastructure across 5 departments per campus, with 5 computers per department
Configured separate SSIDs for student, staff, and guest Wi-Fi networks at both campuses (network segmentation)
Established inter-campus routing and verified end-to-end connectivity via successful ping tests between campuses

coursework.text: Computing Theory / Help Desk (CompTIA A+):
hardware configuration & troubleshooting, memory & motherboard components, mobile device support, laptop hardware & repair, printer installation & management, IT roles and technician best practice
Networking (CompTIA Network+):

IT Service Management (ITIL v3 Foundation):
ITSM fundamentals, service lifecycle, service design (catalogue, SLA, availability, capacity, continuity, security, supplier management), service transition, continual service improvement
